description: React component for configuring map layer settings, including layer type, style, and WFS/WMS parameters, with UI elements and data fetching logic.

classes.name: LayerConfigsPopoverContent
classes.description: React functional component for displaying and editing layer configuration in a popover.

methods.name: onFieldValueChange
methods.description: Updates current layer configuration state when a form field value changes.

methods.name: onLayerTypeChange
methods.description: Handles change of layer type, setting default styles and versions accordingly.

methods.name: onCloseClick
methods.description: Triggers onClose callback to close the popover.

methods.name: onSaveClick
methods.description: Constructs layer configuration object and triggers onSave callback.

methods.name: useEffect (layerConf change)
methods.description: Remounts form and updates currentLayerConf when layerConf prop changes.

methods.name: useEffect (fetch WFS data)
methods.description: Fetches WFS data with debounce when currentLayerConf changes, updates geostylerData.
